A '''Human''' worked for [[Hox Bilan]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] and several companions attacked [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] and [[Eaden Vrill]] in ''[[The Nexu's Den]]'', trying to obtain the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]]. The Human was defeated by Vrill.
